title: A recursive file watch is per-folder on Linux: never make a source all-or-nothing on it
rule: When a watch on a source folder fails (notify `watch(root, Recursive)`), fail the source only when the root itself cannot be read. inotify watches every subfolder on its own and returns an error for one unreadable subfolder or at fs.inotify.max_user_watches, where ReadDirectoryChangesW and FSEvents watch the root alone and succeed. Keep the source, log the partial watch, and let the scans cover the rest; add a test with an OS-watcher stand-in that reports MaxFilesWatch.
rationale: E2.5 (#48): `Worker::add` and resume propagated the recursive watch error, so on Linux a source with one chmod-000 subfolder or a large library was never added or resumed, while Windows and macOS worked.
